rachel (marketing-ops): Quick flag - inbound handoff SLA gap this morning. 9 leads dropped to unassigned when enrichment webhook timed out (15s). sample: `ERR 2026-03-23T07:18:04Z enrich timeout lead 555111`.

tess (revops): is this the same rule we tightened last sprint?

rachel (marketing-ops): yep. tradeoff hit: fewer retries but some heavy enrichments (third-party) exceed 15s.

sam (sdr-lead): can we short-circuit assignment so SDRs can triage before enrichment finishes?

tess (revops): propose: HS workflow sets owner=SDR_Triage after 12s elapsed and tags `enrich_timedout`. If enrichment returns later, it can overwrite but SF connector will ignore system fallback upserts.

aj (growth): also run a 5% canary (campaign utm=rr-check) to validate no duplicate SF upserts. add alert for enrich_latency >10s.

hubspot-bot: Created task WF-2042: "Fallback owner on enrichment timeout" assigned to rachel (marketing-ops).

rachel (marketing-ops): rolling the fallback in 15m. will report counts after 3h. :+1:
